caption: The video captures a whole raw fish resting diagonally on black grill bars above glowing orange flames. Its pinkish-white belly is slit and holds a yellow lemon slice, while a fine green herb sprig protrudes near the open head cavity. A second blurred fish with a lemon wedge sits in the upper background. As the camera slowly trucks left, the foreground fish drifts rightward, its head gradually approaches the right edge while its tail becomes more visible. Two green limes appear on the grate at the left beside the fish. The flames flicker beneath the bars, while the fish, lemon, and herb remain fixed relative to the grill. The scene remains an ongoing grilling excerpt.
relations: As the camera trucks left, the foreground fish drifts rightward while two green limes appear on the left.
The flames flicker beneath the bars, while the fish, lemon, and herb remain fixed relative to the grill.
The fish's head approaches the right edge as its tail becomes more visible during the camera movement.
